title: Zake2002's Server
description: Welcome to Zake2002's Server! It's a network of servers that are bridged together using Velocity. The main server is a survival server but you can reach other bridged servers using the Network Hub! [/hub]
body:
This Minecraft network hosted on bloom.host is where I have my servers bridged together using Velocity as the router to connect them all.

Each server in the network has its own dedicated address to connect through but aren't limited to said addresses, within one server you can jump over to the other servers without having to disconnect.

The Velocity router comes bundled with Geyser, Floodgate, and ViaVersion support built into the network and kept up to date automatically, so you don't have to worry about what client to connect with.

There's a Network Hub in the router itself that lets you see all the connected server portals, accessible with the /hub command. The hub also serves as a fallback if a server went offline, though this is optional for servers not owned by me. Go ahead and try it out!
